{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Final cleaned dataset: no QA orders, no refunded orders
df_final = df[~(df['revenue'] == '999999.99') & (df['status'] != 'refunded')].copy()

# Convert revenue to float (though not used in this analysis)
df_final['revenue_float'] = df_final['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute conversion rate per channel within each segment
stratified_rates = df_final.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='channel')
stratified_rates.columns = ['email_rate', 'paid_search_rate']
stratified_rates['diff'] = stratified_rates['email_rate'] - stratified_rates['paid_search_rate']

# Compute the number of observations in each segment
n_segment = df_final['customer_segment'].value_counts()

# Compute the difference in conversion rates within each segment
# We can only compute differences for segments present in both channels
# 'new' is only in paid_search, so we skip it
# Compute differences for 'loyal' and 'returning'
diff_by_segment = []
for seg in ['loyal', 'returning']:
    if seg in stratified_rates.index:
        email_rate = stratified_rates.loc[seg, 'email_rate']
        paid_search_rate = stratified_rates.loc[seg, 'paid_search_rate']
        diff = email_rate - paid_search_rate
        n = n_segment[seg]
        diff_by_segment.append({'segment': seg, 'diff': diff, 'n': n})

# Convert to DataFrame
diff_by_segment = pd.DataFrame(diff_by_segment)

# Compute weighted average of differences (weighted by segment size)
weighted_diff = (diff_by_segment['diff'] * diff_by_segment['n']).sum() / diff_by_segment['n'].sum()

# Also compute overall conversion rates for comparison
overall_email_rate = df_final[df_final['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
overall_paid_search_rate = df_final[df_final['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
overall_diff = overall_email_rate - overall_paid_search_rate

# Print results
print('Stratified conversion rates by segment:')
print(stratified_rates)
print('\nSegment-specific differences:')
print(diff_by_segment)
print(f'\nWeighted average difference (stratified): {weighted_diff:.4f}')
print(f'Overall difference (unadjusted): {overall_diff:.4f}')"}
